visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a green ribbed sweater and a lace-patterned white top, sits in a busy office environment. A hand enters the frame holding a smartphone which displays an AR camera filter. The background is filled with office desks, monitors, and various items under bright indoor lighting. (2) The woman interacts with the AR filter on the phone. Her facial features—eyes, nose, and mouth—are missing from her face and are seen floating independently above her head on the screen. She looks up and smiles, trying to 'catch' them. (3) A second woman with long dark hair and a beige top is shown laughing in the office. She holds a phone displaying the same filter, which has displaced her mouth to her forehead. She is sitting in a grey office chair. (4) A third woman with short black hair appears against a white brick wall. She wears a cream cardigan and moves her head rapidly up and down to align the floating facial features in the filter. (5) Close-ups of the phone screens show the final distorted results of the challenge, featuring wide eyes and exaggerated mouths. The women are seen laughing and reacting to their funny appearances.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful male voice initiates the video with a high-pitched greeting and challenge. A high-tempo electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 beat starts immediately. (2) A series of 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects are introduced as the filter activates, synchronizing with the visual capture of facial features. (3) Vibrant female laughter and high-energy exclamations in Mandarin fill the audio space, overlapping with the persistent electronic music. (4) A short musical transition occurs, followed by more loud laughter and a second female voice exclaiming in surprise. The BGM remains energetic. (5) The final phase features rapid head movements accompanied by rhythmic percussive thumps in the audio, concluding with a loud, joyful chorus of laughter from all participants.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain the audience by showcasing a trending AR facial filter challenge and capturing the humorous, genuine reactions of staff members in an office setting.
